technical-summary: Added additive HI33 transform evidence schema and an offline loader for validated transform-attempt and transform-gap JSONL. The loader binds records to exact build, hardware, and source-signature provenance, joins gap impact from observation, and supports idempotent reloads without changing runtime transforms or replay/release formats.
user-summary-candidate: Added the bounded HI33 SQLite integration for transform evidence with strict provenance checks, observation impact joins, and regression coverage.
